After 3 hours the effects wears off and the user suffers a penalty of -2 Movement and -20 t o WS, S, T, and Ag. The negative effect lasts for 1 day.

name: False Leg
description: Leg prosthetic. Equipping false leg let's you ignore 1 point of Movement Loss due to missing leg. For 100 XP you can become so proficient in using it that you can ignore another point of Movement Loss. For extra 200 XP you can use Dodge again.

name: Hook
description: Replaces a hand. For 100 XP you can reduce penalty to all Tests requiring both hands by 5. You can keep reducing this penalty 3 more times (each time for 100 XP) until it's completely gone.

name: Cavalry Hammer

description: Hallucinogenic mushrooms used by Goblin fanatics. They induce a berserker state when chewed and for 2d10 minutes after. While the effect lasts, the user gains +10 Strength, +4 Wounds, and the Frenzy Talent. When the effect is over, the user loses 1d10 Wounds. On top of that all non-Greenskins must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or they get a Minor Infection.

name: False Eye

name: Backpack

description: Has calming properties. When chewed and for 2d10 x 10 minutes after, the user must pass a Willpower Test every Round to perform an Action or a Move. Movement is halved, but Cool Tests get +20 bonus.

name: Earth Root
description: Grassland herb available in summer. Negates effects of  Buboes caused by the Black Plague. Provides +10 to all Tests concerning the Black Plague. Dose: 1 per day. In Ulthuan, it is worth 1 GC and is Common rather than Scarce.

name: Davrich Lamp
description: Developed by  Master Engineer Davrich Stephansson, the Lamp is a early warning device. When exposed to firedamp (explosive gasses in mines) it will start to flare brightly. The lamp will cause an explosion of the firedamp after 1d10 rounds of continuous exposure.

name: Digestive Tonic
description:
After drinking, the character gets +20 to recovery Tests from stomach problems, for example: Galloping Trots or Bloody Flux.
In Ulthuan, it costs 1/-.

name: Healing Poultice

gloves

name: Black Lotus
description:
Black lotus grows in Southland jungles. It is used to create deadly blade venom. Anyone who gets at least 1 Wound form a venom-covered blade take 2 Poisoned Conditions. Can be Resisted with a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test.
In Ulthuan it is Scarce rather than Exotic, and costs half of the usual price (10GC).

name: Nightshade
description: Found in coniferous forests during autumn. Eating this herb causes one to fall asleep after 2-3 hours unless they pass an  Endurance Test. The sleep lasts 1d10+4 hours. Dose: 1 per person. In Ulthuan, it has Scarce Availability and costs 1 GC.

name: Leather Jack
description: Leather jacket protecting body and arms.

name: Healing Draught
description: Once per encounter, the Healing Draught can be used to recover Toughness Bonus Wounds immediately. In Ulthuan, it has Common Availability and costs 4/-.

name: Workshop - Apothecary - Large
description: Large apothecary workshop with oil burners and shelves with herbs, draughts, and other ingredients.

name: Zweihander
description: A type of longsword. It is a great sword with two-handed grip, usually 5 ft long, and weighing over 4 lb.

name: Parchment
description: 1 sheet of parchment.

name: Amulet
description: A simple amulet.

description: Book about religion. It is one of the most common types of books.

name: Animal Trap
description: Used to catch game.

description: Usually made out of wood.

name: Nail

name: Sickle

name: Trade Tools - Artisan
description: A set of artisan tools. Varies per trade. For example carpenter has hammer and nails, saw, etc. Engraver has gravers, punches, wax, acid, and similar. Smith's tools include hammer, tongs, etc.

name: Heartkill
description: A combination of venoms from and two-headed serpent Amphisbaena and a Jabberslythe. It is odourless, colourless. Anyone who ingests it suffers 4 Poisoned Conditions unless it is Resisted with a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test.

name: Pistol
description: A compact version of a handgun that can be used with one hand and reloaded more easily.

name: Knife
description: A fine knife.

name: Bracers
description: Plate arms armour. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty.

name: Gloves
description: Pair of average quality gloves.

name: Book - Art
description: May contains plays, poems, etc. Can also include texts about various techniques such as: perspective, sculpturing technique, lighting, or similar.

name: Manacles
description: Shackle for the hands.

name: Jug
description: Holds 1 gallon.

name: Trade Tools - Artist
description: Usually contains equipment for painting and sculpturing: brushes, paints, chisel, etc.

name: Baton
description: A small cylindrical club.

name: Doll
description: A cloth doll.

name: Storm Lantern
description: The shutters protect flame from the wind and can be used to direct the light in a specific direction (90 deg arc) or darken it completely. Illuminates for 20 yards or 30 yards when directed by the shutters.

name: Moonflower
description:
Dried moss from the leaves in the Laurelorn forest.
The effect depends on the species. In case of Elves, it grants a +30 bonus to resist Black Plague.
Other species can inhale  vapours from boiling the moss. They have to take a Very Hard (-30) Willpower Test. If they pass, they receive a bonus of +20 to Cool Tests and a Fatigued Condition, otherwise they gain an Unconscious Condition. The effects lasts 1d10 + 5 hours.
Often it is used as an anesthetic by the most expensive Physicians.
In Ulthuan it has Exotic Availability and costs 7 GC.

name: Spit
description: Extract from Chameleoleeches, this hallucinogen substance creates visions of the lost loved people. When ingested, the user must pass a Very Hard (-30) Toughness Test. If failed, they are lost in a fantasy for 1d10 minutes.

name: False Foot
description: Foot prosthetic. Equipping false foot let's you ignore 1 point of Movement Loss due to missing foot. For 100 XP you can become so proficient in using it that you can ignore another point of Movement Loss. For extra 200 XP you can use Dodge again.

name: Leather Leggings
description: Simple leather leg protection.

name: Grain Flail
description: Grain flail modified to be a weapon.

name: Ear Pick
description: Ear pick.

name: Legal Document
description: A simple legal document.

name: Scroll Case
description: Keeps your scrolls secured.

name: Canvas Tarp
description: A large sheet of canvas.

name: Cup
description: A cup.

name: Instrument - Small
description: A small size musical instrument, for example: flute, recorder, tambourine.

name: Tent - Medium
description: Can fit 4 people in.

name: Engineering Marvel
description: A unique work of art. This prosthetics completely replaces lost body part allowing you to ignore and any penalties due to missing body part. If you receive a critical hit in it, it automatically breaks and needs to be repaired by a specialist for at least 10% of the base cost (depends on the damage).

name: Eonir War Blade
description: Lighter than usual similar Empire weapons, Eonir blades have better balance and are great for swift, precise strikes.

name: Eonir Spear
description: Lighter than usual Empire spears, they have sharper points capable of piercing armour.

name: Wildwood
description: With haft made of living wood, can move much faster than other weapons of this size.

name: Bearded Axe
description: Common dwarven axe, designed to rip weapon away from enemies.

name: Dwarf Hammer
description: Perfect for cracking Orc skulls.

name: Slayer's Axe
description: A very large and scary axe.

name: Nan's Cleaver
description: Suitable for battle and making post-battle stew.

name: Iron Skillet
description: Heavy, good quality iron skillet. When used as weapon, it's quite good in defence.

name: Dwarf Handgun
description: Finely made and carefully reinforced. Compared to Empire weapons, they are less prone to misfires and more lethal to the enemy.

name: Dwarf Pistol
description: Finely made and carefully reinforced. Compared to Empire weapons, they are less prone to misfires and more lethal to the enemy.

name: Dwarf Crossbow
description: Built by best dwarven craftsman, these are usually quite more precise than crossbows made by Humans.

name: Drakefire Pistol
description: Very rare and powerful weapon. Shoots incendiary projectiles that can set enemies ablaze.

name: Cinderblast Bomb
description: Full of shrapnel, creates massive and deadly explosion. Often used in tunnel fighting.

name: Blackbriar Javelin
description: Made of wood from twisted and malign trees, these javelins constantly drip lethal poison.

name: Drakefire Shot
description: Suitable for (and required by) Drakefire Pistol only. If loaded to any other Blackpowder weapon, it will explode after shooting. Resolve it as if Fumble was rolled on every shot.

name: Starfire Shafts
description: Made of wood from Starfire tree, these arrows often set targets ablaze.

name: Swiftshver Shafts
description: Designed specifically to shot multiple arrows at once.

name: Theodolite
description: Device to measure angles over large distances. Requires Trade - Cartographer to use it.

name: Ostrich Feather
description: A very large feather from a strange Arabyan bird.

name: Compass
description:
Rudimentary compass made out of metal needle balanced on a pin. Gives +2 SL to Navigation Tests where knowing which direction is
north is relevant.

name: Bandoleer
description: A leather belt that is worn diagonally, with multiple small containers hanging from it.

name: Slow Match (1 yard)
description: Thin rope infused with flammable substance. It burns slowly (1 foot per hour) and is used to provide spark for a matchlock weapons.

name: Fuse (1 yard)
description: Flammable string use to detonate black powder from a distance. It burns 1 inch per second. Fails about 5% of times over 10 yards.

name: Bow String
description: A piece of string used in bows.

name: Whetstone
description: Used to sharpening blades.

name: Sealskin
description: A sealskin overcoat to protect against bad weather. Good quality sealskin can give bonuses to resist cold exposure.

name: Silk Underwear
description: A little luxury to help to relieve the stress and drudgery of military life.

name: Captain Braun’s Multi-Stove
description: Contraption used for cooking on the road. Has several compartments within it to allow the cooking of different meals at once.

name: Captain Braun’s Insta-Boiler
description: Looks like a tall cooking pot. Used to cook soups and stews on the move.

name: Axe
description: Not as well balanced as sword but good against armor.

name: Ballock Knife
description: Used for stabbing and seeking out the weak points in armor, such as the helmet visor, armpit, and the groin.

name: Club
description: Just a larger piece of wood. Players in wooded areas can take a Extended Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival Test requiring a total of 7 SL to find one.

name: Mace
description: Metal shaft with a heave head. Less balanced that a sword but inflicts concussive blows.

name: Military Pick
description: Basically a metal spike on a stick. Not as agile as sword but good for piercing armor.

name: Scimitar
description: A curved blade good for slashing.

name: Sword
description: A regular sword. Well balanced.

name: Warhammer
description: Is flat and heavy on one side for pummelling damage and has a spike on another for penetrating damage.

name: Pavise
description: A large round wooden shield designed to protect crossbowmen during reload. It costs 2 Actions to set up. After setting up, if the character stays 1 yard behind the Pavise, it has Shield 5 Quality against projectiles. In case of melee attack it provides Shield 5 protection only in the first turn of combat.

name: Demi-Lance
description: Smaller version of Lance. If used by attacker without Charging, it count as Improvised Weapon (SB+1 Damage, Undamaging).

name: Sabre
description: Curved blade similar to Scimitar but a bit more straight and longer. Can be used on foot with Melee - Basic skill but with Slash (2A) instead of Slash (1A) or with Melee - Fencing in which case it retains Slash (1A) Quality.

name: Smallsword
description: A smaller version of the foil. Often not considered a serious weapon. When used in sports contest, it has blunt tips and blades in which case it gains Undamaging Flaw.

name: Spiked Gauntlet
description: Gauntlet with spikes. Can be part of a plate armor, in that case it does not add extra Encumbrance.

name: Garrote
description: A piece of wire intended to be slipped around one's neck. Can be made in a coaching inn or urban location by passing and extended Challenging (+0) Trade (Chandler, Engineer, Tailor, or Tanner) Test requiring a total of 5 SL.

name: Locked Gauntlet
description: Gauntlet that ensure that the wielder does not drop a weapon held in the gauntleted hand. If character is forced to drop the weapon, they suffer -20 penalty to any Tests made with that item. Can be part of a plate armor, in that case it does not add extra Encumbrance.

name: Sap
description: A leather sheath with some small heavy items, for example musket balls. Can be made in a tavern, shop, or urban location by passing and extended Challenging (+0) Trade (Carpenter, Engineer, Smith, Tailor or Tanner) Test requiring a total of 15 SL.

name: Weighted Net
description:
When making a Test to see if an opponent becomes entangled
in a weighted net, the net has a Strength of 55.

name: Ahlspiess
description: A long thin spike on top of a spear shaft.

name: Bill
description: A hooked blade on a long shaft.

name: Mancatcher
description: A Polearm with a semi-circular top with spikes on the inner side. Can be used to trap someone's neck.

name: Mancatcher (spring-loaded)
description: A Polearm with a semi-circular top with spikes on the inner side. Can be used to trap someone's neck. Has an extra spring-loaded mechanism that gives bonus of +20 to any Strength Tests made to entangle.

name: Partizan (Glaive)
description: A spear with a thick leaf shaped blade.

name: Pollaxe
description: Polearm with short spike on the top for Impale, an axe head to one side for Hack, and a hammer head on the other side for Pummel.

name: Flamberge Zweihander
description: A type of longsword. It is a great sword with two-handed grip, usually 5 ft long, and weighing over 4 lb. The blade has waves and serrated edges making it even more deadly.

name: Barbed Arrow
description: The arrowhead has extra hooks that cause deeper wounds.

name: Bodkin Arrow
description: Special arrowhead designed to penetrate armor.

name: Sharp Stick
description: A sharp stick that can be used instead as arrow. Can be sourced in wooded locations by passing an extended Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival Test requiring a total of 10 SL.

name: Pebble
description: A pebble that can b used as projectile for a sling. Can be sourced in a suitable location by passing an extended Easy (+40) Outdoor Survival Test or an extended Challenging (+0) Perception Test requiring a total of 5 SL.

name: Matchlock Handgun
description: Early design of a handgun. Before shooting, the user has to spend 1 Action to light the fuse.

name: Matchlock Blunderbuss
description: Early design of a handgun. Before shooting, the user has to spend 1 Action to light the fuse.

name: Arquebus
description: A very early design of a gun fired from the shoulder. Not very practical, usually kept by nobles seeking to impress visitors.

name: Double-barrelled Handgun
description: A handgun with 2 barrels and 2 triggers. Comes with a device for reloading both barrels at once.

name: Griffonsfoot Pistol
description: Shoots 6 projectiles at a time. Reloading is very difficult and requires 6 bullets and doses of gunpowder.

name: Gun Axe
description: Can we used as Axe with Melee - Basic Skill. If used as an axe while loaded, any critical fumble will discharge the weapon into the torso of the user.

name: Gun Halberd
description: Can we used as Halberd with Melee - Polearm Skill. If used as an axe while loaded, any critical fumble will discharge the weapon into anyone unlucky enough to be standing directly behind the user.

name: Pepperbox
description: A simpler form of a Repeater Pistol. After each shot it has to be manually rotated, cranked, or otherwise manually prepared to fire again. Because of that it needs a second hand to operate or it loses its Repeater Quality.

name: Hand Mortar
description: A scaled down mortar deigned to shoot bombs or other large projectiles.  Any fumble while reloading the weapon causes it to explode.

name: Cane Pistol
description: A pistol concealed in a walking stick or cane. In order to detect it, one must pass a Hard (-20) Perception Test, or a Very Hard (-30) Perception Test if they are unfamiliar with blackpowder weapons.

name: Paper Cartridge
description: Pre-prepared packages of shot and powder, make reloading easier. Give +10 bonus to all reload Tests.

name: Aqshy-Infused Powder
description: More explosive than normal powder. Any failed Test that includes either an 8 or 9 on either the 10s or units die counts as a Fumble when using this powder.

name: Precision Shot and Powder
description: Extra high quality powder and bullets.

name: Scrap and Powder
description: Made out of really nasty stuff like roofing nails, used horseshoe fragments, arrow heads etc.

name: Large Bullet and Powder
description: Can be loaded to large guns such as Arquebus or Hand Mortar. When fired, anyone within 2 yards (including the shooter) has to make Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain a Deafened Condition.

name: Bomb (Ammunition)
description: Can be loaded into Hand Mortar. Fuse must be lit before loading.

name: Incendiary (Ammunition)
description: Can be loaded into Hand Mortar. Fuse must be lit before loading.

name: Grapple
description: Hook with some rope attached. Can be shot from Hand Mortar. May be used to attach a rope to a distant point, or snare an escaping enemy, in which case it inflicts one Entangled Condition on a successful hit.

name: Silver
description: Silver bar weighing 1 pound.

name: Bladder of Liftgas
description: A pig’s bladder filled with a volatile lighter-than-air gas.

name: Keg of Blackpowder
description: Contains enough for 12 horns, which each contain enough for 12 shots.

name: Keg of Improved Blackpowder
description: Contains enough for 12 horns, which each contain enough for 12 shots. Improved blackpowder reduces reload time by 1 (to a minimum of 1) and allows to make a Challenging (+0) Ranged (Blackpowder or Engineering) Test to ignore the effects of misfire

name: Soap
description: A bar of soap.

name: Dye - Green
description: A small vial of green dye. Enough to change colour of a single set of cloths.

name: Dye - Yellow
description: A small vial of yellow dye. Enough to change colour of a single set of cloths.

name: Dye - Red
description: A small vial of red dye. Enough to change colour of a single set of cloths.

name: Dye - Blue
description: A small vial of blue dye. Enough to change colour of a single set of cloths.

name: Dye - Purple
description: A small vial of purple dye. Enough to change colour of a single set of cloths.

name: Vial of Corrosive Liquid
description: A small vial of corrosive liquid.

name: Magnet
description: A small magnet.

name: Prism
description: A small chunk of glass. When white light passes through it is split into multiple colours.

name: Periscope
description: 1 yard long. A set of mirrors allowing the user to see from a point of view 1 yard above their had.

name: Ogre Club (with Metal Plates)
description: "Average" size ogre club. This one is customised with metal plates around it. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Ogre Club (with Rusty Spikes)
description: "Average" size ogre club. This one is customised with rusty spikes sticking out of it. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Ogre Club (with Scavenged Blades)
description: "Average" size ogre club. This one is customised with blades attached to it. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Ironfist
description: Massive ogre ironfist. They are tightly attached to user's hand so that user cannot be disarmed. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Big Ogre Club (with Metal Plates)
description: Large size ogre club. This one is customised with metal plates around it. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Big Ogre Club (with Rusty Spikes)
description: Large size ogre club. This one is customised with rusty spikes sticking out of it. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Big Ogre Club (with Scavenged Blades)
description: Large size ogre club. This one is customised with blades attached to it. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Great Throwing Spear
description: Ogre throwing spear. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Leadbelcher Gun
description: Essentially a cannon, Leadbelcher Gun is the most advanced Ogre weapon. Breech loaded and fired by lighting a simple fuse. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Ogre Pistol
description: Large size ore pistol. Uses the same shot and powder as typical blackpowder pistol. It is strong enough to serve as Hand Weapon but it will break on Fumbled attack. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Harpoon Launcher
description: Ogre launcher that shoots a massive bolts attached to a rope. There is no mechanism to automatically pull back the rope. Can be used with either Ranged - Crossbow or Ranged - Entangling Skills without penalty. If the rope is removed from the bolt, the range increases to 60 but Entangle Quality is lost. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Chain Trap
description: Ogre weapon. It is a massive spring-loaded metal jaws attached to a chain. Usable only by large creatures.

name: Leadbelcher Shot
description: Shot for Leadbelcher Gun.

name: Leadbelcher Ball
description: A cannon ball that can be shot from Leadbelcher Gun. The price includes 2/- worth of powder to fire a single shot. The ball itself can usually be recovered and re-used.

name: Harpoon
description: Ammunition for Ogre Harpoon Launcher.

name: Ogre Gutplate
description: A massive slab of metal, hardwood, bone or leather, it protects the Ogre's belly, where most of their vital organs reside. They are uniquely suited to Ogre anatomy, and indeed even if scaled down, would be no good for other species.

name: Soft Kit
description: A woollen doublet that is worn under armour. This armour uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Reinforced Soft Kit
description: A woollen doublet that is worn under armour. This armour uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Leather Jack - v2
description: Boiled leather jacket protecting body and arms. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Leather Jerkin - v2
description: Close-fitting, sleeveless boiled leather jacket. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Leather Leggings - v2
description: Simple boiled leather leg protection. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Leather Skullcap - v2
description: Boiled leather head protection. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Chainmail Chausses - v2
description: Chainmail leg armour. Wearing any Mail imposes a  -10 Stealth Penalty. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Chainmail Coat - v2
description: Chainmail body and arms armour. Wearing any Mail imposes a  -10 Stealth Penalty. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Chainmail Coif - v2
description: Chainmail head armour. It has -10 Perception penalty. Wearing any Mail imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Chainmail Shirt - v2
description: Chainmail body armour. Does not protect arms. Wearing any Mail imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Brigandine Jack
description: Leather jacket lined internally with small oblong steel plates riveted to the fabric. This armour uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Brigandine Jerkin
description: Close-fitting, sleeveless leather jacket lined internally with small oblong steel plates riveted to the fabric. This armour uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Bracers - v2
description: Plate arms armour. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Breastplate - v2
description: Plate body armour. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Open Helm - v2
description: Open plate head armour. It imposes -10 to Perception. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Plate Leggings - v2
description: Plate legs armour. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Great Helm
description: Archetypal fully enclosed plate helm. It's considered old fashioned in Tilea and the Empire but still widely used in Bretonnia. It imposes -20 to Perception. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Bascinet
description: Plate helmet with conical visor. It provides 4 APs (instead of 3) against projectiles shot at the visor. It imposes -20 to Perception. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Armet
description: Plate helmet with designed to withstand more blows than other helmets. It imposes -20 to Perception. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Sallet
description: Plate helmet that provides extra neck protection. It reduces Critical Hit Damage to head area by 1. It imposes -20 to Perception. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Practical Robes
description: Practical wizard robes.These are simple and comfortable costumes that come at an affordable price. They have a plain appearance, making it possible for a wizard dressed in them to blend in unnoticed in various situations.

name: Standard Robes
description: The standard wizard robes are elaborate costumes that usually consist of thick coats or cloaks and unique headwear.

name: Elaborate Robes
description: Elaborate wizard robes are extravagant and cumbersome costumes that often feature oversized accessories and yards of fabric woven with enchanted thread. These robes are not practical to wear and are intended to make a statement. They are easily recognisable as wizard attire and will draw attention to the wearer.

name: Obsinite Club
description: Small club made out of obsinite and lined with bronze. Price and availability assumes the weapon is being purchased in Lustria, for example Skeggi or Port Reaver. It is much more expensive and hard to get outside of Lustria.

name: Obsinite Spiked Maul
description: Large maul made out of obsinite and lined with bronze. Price and availability assumes the weapon is being purchased in Lustria, for example Skeggi or Port Reaver. It is much more expensive and hard to get outside of Lustria.

name: Blowpipe
description: Used to shoot poisonous darts. Gains Dangerous Flaw when used without Ranged - blowpipe Skill. Price and availability assumes the weapon is being purchased in Lustria, for example Skeggi or Port Reaver. It is much more expensive and hard to get outside of Lustria.

name: Blowpipe Dart
description: Blowpipe dart. Usually covered with poison. Price and availability assumes the weapon is being purchased in Lustria, for example Skeggi or Port Reaver. It is much more expensive and hard to get outside of Lustria.

name: Agurk
description: Grassland herb available in autumn. When inhaled (infusion) the target has to pass Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or starts to mildly shake (-20 Dex). When drank (draught), the target receives 2 Poisoned Conditions, resisted with a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test.

name: Alfunas
description: Coniferous forest herb available in summer and autumn. When applied daily to a dislocated or broken bone (as poultice) it halves the usual healing time.

name: Gesundheit
description: Mixed forest herb available in spring and winter. Can be applied once a day to a Festering Wound as poultice. Each time, the target makes an Average (+20) Endurance Test. Reduce the duration of Festering Wound by 1 day for each SL.

name: Graveroot
description: Found in Forest clearings and graveyards during autumn and winter. Smeared on the weapon (raw) causes 1 Poisoned Condition to creatures with Undead Trait unless they pass a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test. A poultice of Graveroot applied to Festering Wound caused by Undead with the Infected Trait adds +20 to all Tests against the Festering Wound. Can be applied once per day. When ingested as draught, it makes the body cold in touch for 1d10+2 hours.

name: Juck
description: Forest herb available during spring. 1d10 minutes after contact with its juice (raw), the affected area becomes itchy for 2d10 + 40 minutes causing -20 to all Tests. The target can make a Challenging (+0) WP Test to ignore the itching for 10 * (1 + SL) minutes, totally negating the penalty with 2 or more SLs. It can also be applied as poultice to speed up frostbite healing. One dose will heal 1d10 wounds lost to the effects of Exposure to cold weather. Can be repeated daily.

name: Mage-Leaf
description: Hills herb available during spring. When eaten raw, each dose gives +10 to the next Casting Test. With each dose roll 1d10, if the number is lower or equal the number of doses already eaten  that day, the dose has no effect.

name: Schlafenkraut
description: Grassland herb available during spring. Infusion takes effect after 2d10 + 10 and puts the target to sleep. During first 4 hours chances of being woken by noise ale halved. Draught works the same but effect comes after 1d10 minutes and target is harder to wake up for 2 hours.

name: Slowmind
description: Marsh herb available during autumn. Anyone who drinks its infusion, must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or suffer a -10 Int and -10 WP for 2d10 + 4 hours. A poultice can be used to remove a Bleeding Condition for a wound.

name: Sigmafoil
description: Marsh herb available during summer. Speeds up healing.

name: Speckled Rustwort
description: Hills herb available during spring. When ingested raw, it provides +10 to all Tests related to Packer’s Pox. As draguht, it reduces the duration of the Packer’s Pox by 1d10 days.

name: Spellwort
description: Forest herb available during summer. Infusion causes -10 penalty to all spellcasting Tests and +10 to all Tests to resist magic for (10 - T Bonus) hours. Draught has the same effect but for 1 hour only. However, the affected person will appear completely mundane to Second Sight.

name: Spiderleaf
description: Herb found in coniferous forest during autumn. Applied raw to a wound, on a successful Heal Test, it removes a Bleeding Condition. As poultice, it has similar effect but removes 1 extra Bleeding Condition for every SL of the Heal Test.

name: Tarrabeth
description: Herb found in mixed forests during summer. Poultice applied to a wound, sends the person into 24h deep sleep. The Endurance Test made to recover Wounds that day is Very Easy (+60). Can also be applied to weapons. When struck, the target must make a  Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or suffer a Fatigued Condition.

name: Trinkwort
description: Herb found in forests during autumn. Eaten raw, it gives +20 bonus to Consume Alcohol Tests for the next 24 hours.

name: Valerian
description: Herb found in mixed forests during spring. Valerian infusion restores 1 Wound. The dose may be repeated once per day. Has no effect on Critical Wounds.

name: Vanera
description: Herb found on hills during spring. When ingested raw, the person is treated as resting. If the person rests during that time, the benefits of rest are doubled. After the dose wears off, it gives 1 Fatigued Condition for 1 hour.

name: Vigwort
description: Grassland herb available in summer. Vigwort infusion gives +10 I for 1d10 +4 minutes. After is wears off, the character must make an Average (+20) Endurance Test or gain a Fatigued Condition for each level of failure.

name: Estalian Mosca
description: Clear oily liquid. Each dose boosts T and Ag by +10 but lowers Int and WP by -10. It also removes all Fatigued Conditions and no new can be gained until the effect wears off. The effect lasts T Bonus hours.

name: Potion of Resistance
description: The drinker receives 3 Stunned Conditions, and cannot make Endurance Tests to remove them until the effects of the potion wear of. During that time, they also gain the Immunity to Psychology and Painless Traits. The effect lasts 2+d10 hours.

name: Barbed Net
description:
Has a Strength of 50. Each attempt to escape it inflicts 1 Wound,
regardless of the T Bonus or Armour.

name: Potion of Flight
description: Drinker gains Flight Creature Trait for 20 Rounds minus Toughness Bonus.

name: Beast-Prod
description: Skaven Moulder clan weapon. Barbed prod is used primarily for herding Rat Ogres, Ignores all Armour.

name: Pavise - Skaven version
description: Large shield designed to shield small-crewed weapons from enemy fire. It makes all ranged attacks targeting the crew Hard (-20).

name: Plague Censer
description: Skaven Pestilens clan weapon. All living creatures around this weapon suffer exposure to Corruption. 8 yards - Minor, 4 yards - Moderate, 2 yards - Major.

name: Punch Dagger
description: Skaven Eshin clan weapon.

name: Rat Claws
description: Skaven Eshin clan weapon. Provides +10 to all Climb Tests.

name: Tail Weapon
description: Weapon designed to be held or attached to your tail. Requires being a Skaven and having Tail Fighting Talent.

name: Things-Catcher
description: Skaven Moulder clan weapon.

name: Poisoned Wind Globe
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. When the globe shatters it releases a poisonous cloud 3 yd in diameter and 3 yd high that lasts for  1d10-1 rounds. All creatures within the cloud have to pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test every round or suffer a +4 Damage hit that ignores AP and T Bonus.

name: Death Globe
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. When the globe shatters it releases a poisonous cloud 4.5 yd in diameter and 3.75 yd high that lasts for  1d10-1 rounds. All creatures within the cloud have to pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test every round or suffer a +1d10 Damage hit that ignores AP.

name: Doomrocket Launcher
description: Skaven Skryre clan handheld rocket launcher. It is very unreliable, in case of fumble roll on table on p. 34.

name: Electro-Whip
description: Skaven Moulder clan weapon.

name: Infernal Bomb
description: Skaven Eshin clan weapon. Can be set up to detonate for up to 10 rounds after it is dropped or thrown.

name: Doomrocket
description: Ammunition for Doomrocket Launcher.

name: Poisoned Wind Mortar
description: Skaven Skryre clan Poisoned Wind Globe launcher. Requires a team of 2 Skavens. The Enc value applies to main gunner. Has a min. range of 20.

name: Ratling Gun
description: Skaven Skryre clan Poisoned Wind Globe launcher. Requires a team of 2 Skavens. The Enc value applies to main gunner.

name: Ratling Gun Belt
description: Ammunition for Ratling Gun.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Skaven Eshin clan weapon. Creates smoke in area of 2 yd radius for 1d10 rounds. It prevent all ranged attacks, magic missiles, and attacks that relay on sight.

name: Snare-Net
description: Skaven Eshin clan weapon.  It causes twice the normal number of Entangled Conditions.

name: Warpfire Thrower
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. Requires a team of 2 Skavens. The Enc value applies to main gunner. Anyone hit by Warpfire Thrower must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain an Ablaze condition. Very unreliable, if the attack results in a Fumble, roll on the table on p. 36.

name: Warpfire Fuel Vat
description: Ammunition for Warpfire Thrower.

name: Warp-grinder
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. Requires a team of 2 Skavens. The Enc value is split between them. Mainly use to dig. It can cut a 5 ft diameter tunnel at a Movement rate of 2.

name: Warplock Jezzail - v2
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. Usually requires a second Skaven to hold and stabilise the barrel. Can use regular blackpowder and shot but this reduces its Range to 72 and Damage to +5. In case of a Fumble, roll 1d10. On 1, the riffle explodes in a Blast 1 explosion dealing the same Damage as a successful shot. On 2-10 roll on the table in WFRP on page 160.

name: Warplock Jezzail
description: Skaven large rifle.

name: Warplock Pistol - v2
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. In case of a Fumble, roll 1d10. On 1, the riffle explodes in a Blast 1 explosion dealing the same Damage as a successful shot. On 2-10 roll on the table in WFRP on page 160.

name: Warpmusket - v2
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. Can be loaded with either a regular Warpstone Bullet, or with Warpstone Buckshot. In case of a Fumble, roll 1d10. On 1, the riffle explodes in a Blast 1 explosion dealing the same Damage as a successful shot. On 2-10 roll on the table in WFRP on page 160.

name: Warplock Pistol
description: Skaven pistol.

name: Warpmusket
description: Skaven musket.

name: Warpstone Star
description: Skaven Eshin clan weapon.

name: Jezzail Bullet and Powder
description: Ammunition for Warplock Jezzail.

name: Warpstone Bullet and Powder
description: Ammunition for Warplock Pistol and Warpmusket.

name: Warpstone Buckshot
description: Ammunition for Warpmusket.

name: Gas Mask
description: Skaven Skryre clan item. Provides +40 to all Endurance Tests made to resist the effects of inhaled poisons or gasses.

name: Liber Bubonicus
description: Skaven Pestilens clan item. Contains a details recording of every corruption and plague since the clan’s emergence.

name: Skalm
description: Skaven ointment. Instantly cures 1d10 + 1 Wounds but each use counts as Moderate Exposure to Corruption.

name: Skavenbrew
description: Skaven drink. For effect roll 1d100 on table on p. 40. The effect lasts for 2d10 - T Bonus (min. 1). No-Skaven must make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test when the effects ends. If they fail, they gain 1 Poisoned and 1 Bleeding Condition. In case of Astounding Failure, they also suffer 1 Ablaze Condition.

name: Warp Scroll - Bless with Filth
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Bless with Filth - v2
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Cloud of Corruption
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Mantle of Contagion
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Pestilent Breath
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Poisonous Pustule
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Putrefy
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Toxic Rain
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Veil of Flies
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Weeping Wound
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warp Scroll - Wither
description: Pestilens clan item. Contains a spell that can be cast once without a Casting Test. There is no chance of a miscast or a critical.

name: Warlock Optics
description: Skaven Skryre clan item. When attached to a ranged weapon, it negates difficulty penalties for shooting at a target in cover.

name: Warp Energy Condenser
description: Skaven Skryre clan item. When used with a Warp-blade, the blade gains +1 Damage.

name: Warp-Blade Halberd
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. The blade is surrounded by tangle of wires that feed the blade with Warp energy.

name: Warp-Blade Hand Weapon
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. The blade is surrounded by tangle of wires that feed the blade with Warp energy.

name: Warp-Power Accumulator
description: Skaven Skryre clan item. When equipped, improves Warp Lightning Spell. The caster can reverse the dice used for the Casting Test. In case of miscast, the caster must pass a Hard (-30) Dexterity Test to disable the device or it explodes dealing 3d10 Damage to everyone within 3 yds and counts as  Moderate Exposure to Corruption to everyone within 5 yds.

name: Warpstone Token
description: Coins with addition of Warpstone. The Skaven use is at fuel and currency.

name: Dark Kiss
description: Skaven poison. Anyone damaged by a weapon covered with it, must make a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test or suffer 3 more Wounds that ignore AP and T Bonus.

name: Foolmaker
description: Skaven poison. Anyone damaged by a weapon covered with it, must make a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or roll on the Stinking Drunk table (WFRP, p. 121). While under the influence, every time they are asked a question, they must pass a Difficult (-10) Willpower Test or they answer truthfully.

name: Warpstone Snuff
description: Skaven Warpstone powder. When consumed, it grants (one time) +1 SL to Channelling Test. In case of a miscast, the caster has to add +10 to any roll on the miscast.

name: Warpstone Charm
description: Allows any Skaven who wears it to reroll a single Test once every 13 hours.

name: Man-trap
description: Trap made of semi-circular jaws that spring when a victim steps on it. The hit is determined by performing opposed Perception Test (vs Set Trap Test). Does SB+4 Dmg (Leg hits only) and has Fast and Penetrating Qualities. If the trap is chained, the victim is held in place until freed, otherwise it causes 1 Entangled Condition. Can opened on a successful Difficult (-10) Strength Test.

name: Cinderblast Bomb - v2
description: Full of shrapnel, creates massive and deadly explosion. Often used in tunnel fighting.

name: Ghostsmear
description: Non-magical weapons covered with Ghostsmear can hit creatures with Ethereal Trait. The effects lasts for 1 hour but stops immediately if the weapon is used to wound a living creature. Can only be made by  priests of Morr and requires 3 GC worth of ingredients. Can be stored for 1 year.

name: Purple Cap Mushrooms
description: When consumed grants powerful visions of past and future. To determine the effects, Roll 1d100 on table on p. 31.

name: Quietened Chainmail Chausses
description: Chainmail leg armour. Wearer can only whisper.

name: Quietened Chainmail Coat
description: Chainmail body and arms armour. Wearer can only whisper.

name: Quietened Chainmail Coif
description: Chainmail head armour. It has -10 Perception penalty. Wearer can only whisper.

name: Quietened Chainmail Chausses - v2
description: Chainmail leg armour. Wearer can only whisper. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Quietened Chainmail Coat - v2
description: Chainmail body and arms armour. Wearer can only whisper. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Quietened Chainmail Coif - v2
description: Chainmail head armour. It has -10 Perception penalty. Wearer can only whisper. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Throatseeker's Blade
description: Ignores any AP provided by armour that has the Weakpoints Flaw.

name: Liber Chaotica
description: A five-volume exploration of the nature of Chaos written by Richter Kless.

name: Boar's Musk
description: Potion. Onset time: 2 hours. Drinker suffers -2 SL to all Fel and Dex based Tests. They also gain Distracting Creature Trait. Lasts 1d10 hours.

name: Channelpath Potion
description: Potion. Onset time: immediate. Drinker gains + 2 SL to all Channelling Tests. Lasts 1d10 minutes.

name: Debauch’s Friend
description: Potion. Onset time: 1d10 minutes. Drinker passes all Consume Alcohol Tests. Lasts 1d10 hours.

name: Draught of Power
description: Potion. Onset time: 1 round. Reduce spell and ritual CNs by half. Lasts 2d10 rounds.

name: Hair Tonic
description: Potion. Onset time: 15 minutes. Cases hair growth to applied body area. One dose is enough to cover whole human scalp. Lasts until hair naturally falls out.

name: Lucidity Tonic
description: Potion. Onset time: 1 hour. Gives the drinker +1 SL to all Int and WP based Tests and immunity to Fatigued Condition. Lasts 3d10 hours, after which the drinker receives 3 Fatigued Conditions.

name: Nectar of Beauty
description: Potion. Onset time: 1 hour. Drinker gains +1 SL to all Fel based Tests involving characters that are ordinarily attracted to the drinker's species and gender. Lasts 3d10 hours.

name: Nectar of Veracity
description: Potion. Onset time: 1 hour. Drinker has to pass a Hard (-20) Cool Test every time they want to lie. Lasts 3d10 hours.

name: Nectar of Vitality
description: Potion. Onset time: 1 round. Drinker gains Regenerate Creature Trait. Lasts 3d10 minutes.

name: Panacea Universalis
description: Potion. Onset time: 1d10 rounds. Drinker recovers 3 times T Bonus Wounds. It removes any Bleeding or Fatigued Conditions. Removes any diseases on a successful Average (+20) Endurance Test. Can remove Critical Injury (see table on p. 163).

name: Potency Draught
description: Potion. Onset time: 1d10 rounds. Drinker gains +2 to S and T Bonus. They also gain +2 SL to any S or T based Test. Lasts 1d10 hours.

name: Potion of Flight - v2
description: Potion. Onset time: 1d10 rounds. Drinker gains Flight (20) Creature Trait. Lasts 1d10 minutes.

name: Potion of Fortune
description: Potion. Onset time: 1 round. Drinker can make an Easy (+40) Augury using their Int if they do not have the Augury Skill.

name: Potion of Invisibility
description: Potion. Onset time: 1d10 rounds. Drinker becomes invisible. Creatures with Second Sight Talent may detect the drinker but suffer a -2 SL penalty on their Perception Test. Lasts 1d10 minutes.

name: Dreamwine
description: Special wine that can be used with Augury Skill. After drinking you must pass a Challenging (+0) Consume Alcohol Test. If you fail the Test the following apply. Gain Sixth Sense and Magical Sense Talents and receive a +2 SL bonus to any Intuition based Tests. You can chose to gain an extra Fortune point or make a roll on the Augury Table using your Intelligence rather than the Augury Skill. Consuming the wine, causes Minor Corruption Exposure. You must also pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or will "hear the call". If you hear the call more times than you WP Bonus you abandon your life and travel to the Grey Mountain vineyards.

name: Gromril Helm
description: Gromil Open Helm.

name: Gromril Helm  - v2
description: Gromil Open Helm. It is marked as v2 because this is a new version of an armour from the Rulebook that has different properties and uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III.

name: Magical Dagger
description: A Dagger that is Magical.

name: Enchanted Spyglass
description: An Arabyan spyglass. Can see through any obfuscation, including magical.

name: Jarl Fur Jacket
description: Prevent the wearer from suffering any natural temperature extremes (both hot and cold).

name: Roth's Moondial
description: Device that can track Morrslieb's movements.

name: Cloak of Feathers
description: The wearer gains Flight (45) and Magic Resistance (2) Creature Traits.

name: Plaguesword
description: Every time a creature is wounded by a it, they must take a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test or suffer a Poisoned Condition.

name: Ameliorative Elixir
description:
Made out of Weirdroot. Gives +10 bonus to WP Tests and -10 to
Ag, I, and Int Tests. Effect lasts 1d10 x 10 minutes.

name: Focusing Philtre
description: Gives +20 to Int and Endurance Tests. Effect lasts 1d10 hours. After than gain 1 Fatigued Condition that lasts for at least a day.

name: Katya's Cordial
description: Drinker gains receives the benefit of the Attractive Talent for 1d10 hours. After it wears off, they suffer -20 to all Fel tests for 1d10 days.

name: Liquor of Luck
description: Gain +1 Fortune point for 1d10 minutes. If you spend that point roll d100, if you roll a double, regain it. When the effect wears off, you lose all your Fortune points and gain 1 Fatigued Condition that lasts for at least a day.

name: The Marvellous Medicinal Mixture
description: To drink it, you must first pass an Average (+20) Cool Test. If successful, gain 1 Fatigued Condition which can only be removed after a good night's rest. There are no other effects.

name: Reactionary Restorative
description: While under its effect, you cannot gain Surprised Condition. Lasts 1d10 hours. After it wears off, gain 1 Fatigued Condition that lasts at least a day.

name: Tonic of Sight Beyond Sight
description: Roll 1d10. Depending on result gain 1 of the following Talents for: 1d10 minutes: 1-2: Acute Sense - Sight, 3-4: Holy Visions, 5-6: Magical Sense, 7-8: Second Sight, 9-10: all of the above.

name: Bezoar Solvent
description: Antidote. Forms: potion. Does nothing on its own. When combined with a poison, it becomes antidote to that exact poison.

name: Bloodblind
description: Concoction. Forms: raw, potion. Grants Painless Creature Trait for 1 hour.

name: Carroburg Fire
description: Concoction. Forms: potion. Grants Breath +10 (Fire) Creature Trait for 1 time use. Immediately after breathing fire, the user must pass a a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain 1 Ablaze Condition.

name: Clearmind
description: Concoction. Forms: potion. Grants Cold-blooded Creature Trait. The drinker can reverse any failed Willpower based Tests. If they gain Surprised Condition, it is not lost  the first time it should be.

name: Flesh Blister
description: Poison. Forms: potion, unguent, raw. If a weapon covered with it inflicts at least 1 Wound, it inflicts additional 1d10 Wounds. If consumed in any form, one has to pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or suffer an immediate Critical Hit to the torso.

name: Forge Shield
description: Concoction. Forms: unguent. Grants 4 AP against all fire damage and immunity to the Ablaze Condition. The user also suffer -20 to Ag and I. Effect lasts 1 hour.

name: Last Gasp
description: Concoction. Forms: potion. Can be used on a corpse not older than 1 day. The corpse can be asked 3 questions. If it is asked a fourth question, it will rise as a Thing from the Dead Wood.

name: Liquid Fire
description: Concoction. Forms: potion. When poured out, it immediately starts to burn on any surface. If used as weapon, it can be treated as Incendiary bomb. Any Ablaze Condition gained from it cannot be put out for 3 rounds.

name: Longsleep
description: Poison. Forms: potion. Very difficult to detect, any attempt suffers a -40 penalty. When ingested, the target must pass s a Hard (-20) Endurance Test. If they fail, they feel tired a little earlier than usual. After they go to sleep, they must attempt another Hard (-20) Endurance Test. If they fail that one as well, they die in their sleep from seemingly natural causes.

name: Laurek's Cure
description: Antidote. Forms: potion. Within 1 minute after drinking, the target becomes sober. The drinker becomes Fatigued for number of hours equal to 10 minus their Toughness Bonus.

name: Preyton's Fury
description: Concoction. Forms: potion, unguent, raw. Grants Frenzy for 1d10 Rounds.

name: Razorburn
description: Concoction. Forms: potion, unguent. Creates a magical fire. When used as incendiary bomb, attacks count as Magical. Unguent can be smeared on the weapon and set alight for 1d10 Rounds. During that time the weapon inflicts a single Ablaze Condition with each strike and counts as Magical.

name: Seer Snake Liquor
description: Concoction. Forms: potion, unguent. Imbiber must pass a  Consume Alcohol Test. If the succeed they can spend a Fortune Point within the next hour to reverse the dice of any failed Test.

name: Spite
description: Concoction. Forms: potion. The drinker must take a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test. If they fail, they gain 2 Poisoned Conditions. If they pass, they gain Corrosive Blood Creature Trait for 3 + SL Rounds.

name: Stag's Ward
description: Concoction. Forms: potion. Drinker becomes immune to all poisons for 1 hour.

name: Tide Blood
description: Concoction. Forms: potion. The imbiber gains 3 Poisoned Conditions (cannot be resisted), recovers T Bonus of Wounds, and gains Regenerate Creature Trait. Regenerate Creature Trait lasts for as long as the last Poisoned Condition.

name: Treemeld
description: Concoction. Forms: unguent. When applied, covered body parts change colour to match the environment. Gives +40 to Stealth Tests relying on sight.

name: Troll Acid
description:
Concoction. Forms: potion, raw. Extremally corrosive. If used as a weapon, causes +9 Damage and has Penetrating Quality and
Dangerous Flaw.

name: Two-Headed Tincture
description:
Antidote. Forms: potion, unguent. Grants +40 bonus to resist
the effects of any poison.

name: Veinpowder
description: Concoction. Forms: potion, unguent. Used to treat wounds. When applied as unguent, it removes all Bleeding Conditions without a Heal Test. In potion form, it removes 1 Bleeding Condition at the end of each Round for 1 hour. In addition, vampires do not heal Wounds if they drink imbiber's blood.

name: Wheeze
description: Poison. Forms: potion. Causes unusual fatigue for 6 hours. Any moderate physical task inflicts a Fatigued Condition. Anything that would normally result in Fatigued Condition, inflicts 2 Conditions instead. At the end of each hour, the victim may attempt a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test to shake off this effect. If they pass they no longer gain Fatigued Conditions due to Wheeze.

name: Witchbane
description: Concoction. Forms: potion. Grants Magic Resistance 3 Creature Trait for 1 hour. If used multiple times, each dose increases resistance by 1 and duration by 1 hour. For each dose consumed after the first, the imbiber must make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test. If they fail, they  receive 1 Poisoned Condition each Round for 10 Rounds. All Poisoned Conditions are removed after 10 Rounds.

name: Wyvern's Kiss
description: Poison. Forms: unguent. Whenever a weapon covered with it causes at least 1 Wound, the victim must pass Endurance Test or take an additional 5 Wounds that ignore Toughness and AP. It evaporates from weapons within 2+1d10 Rounds.

name: Warp Blade
description: Skaven Skryre clan weapon. Ignores Metal Armour. If it causes at least 1 Wound, the victim has to pass an Average (+20) Endurance Test or gain a Stunned Condition.

name: Magical Dagger - copy
description: A Dagger that is Magical.

name: Eagle Shank
description: Dwarf dagger made out of Great Eagle Talon.

name: Fell Dagger
description: Every time this dagger inflicts at least 1 Wound, the target immediately take a Poisoned Condition resisted with a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test. When the poison runs dry, Fell Dagger shatters.

name: Antler Hilted Blade
description: Sword with hilt made of Great Stag Antler. Even though it can corrode, crack or bend, it will never break in battle.

name: Antler Hilted Blade - Bleeding
description: Sword with hilt made of Great Stag Antler. Even though it can corrode, crack or bend, it will never break in battle. Inflicts Bleeding Condition on both its wielder and its victim every time it is used to inflict a Critical Wound.

name: Leviathan Breastplate
description: Plate body armour. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. Uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III. Lighter than usual because it is made out of Leviathan Scale or Carapace.

name: Leviathan Plate Leggings
description: Plate legs armour. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. Uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III. Lighter than usual because it is made out of Leviathan Scale or Carapace.

name: Leviathan Helm
description: Open plate head armour. It imposes -10 to Perception. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. Uses new rules from Archives of the Empire Vol III. Lighter than usual because it is made out of Leviathan Scale or Carapace.

name: Griffon Fletching Arrow
description: Made with Griffon Feathers by the master-fletchers of Ostermark.

name: Griffon Fletching Bolt
description: Made with Griffon Feathers by the master-fletchers of Ostermark.

name: Tregara Sap
description: Can be used to cover up to 6 bolts of arrows to give them Penetrating Quality. Once covered, they have to be used within 1 day. After 1 day they become useless.

name: Shard Tips Bolt
description:
Any attack that inflict at least 1 Wound, also inflicts one
Bleeding Condition.

name: Shard Tips Arrow
description:
Any attack that inflict at least 1 Wound, also inflicts one
Bleeding Condition.

name: Bone Smasher
description: Is flat and heavy on one side for pummelling damage and has a spike on another for penetrating damage. After killing an opponent, every living creature within 10 yards, other than the wielder of the hammer, must make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain a Deafened Condition and suffer 1d10 Wounds which bypass AP.

name: Silence Sword
description: A regular sword. Well balanced. Contains Siren hair in the hilt. The wielder cannot speak, scream etc.

name: Silence Dagger
description: Deadlier version of a knife. Contains Siren hair in the hilt. The wielder cannot speak, scream etc.

name: Wightseer
description: Bearer can see Undead creature as they looked in life. This removes the Fear Trait of any Undead, unless whatever creature they were in life would naturally have this Trait.

name: Throttler's Gloves
description: For the purposes of Opposed Strength Tests, the wearer counts their size as one step larger than it actually is.

name: Wulfshawl
description: This Cloak grant Fear 2 in Wolves, Lions, Goats, and Chimeras.

name: The Last Toast
description: A cup made out of a skull of Undead. By drinking from the cup, the imbiber can see and talk to ghosts an spirits. The effects lasts 1 minute but may be extended by taking more sips.

name: The Thristy Stone
description: Magical ruby can absorb any blood. When it does, it grants Ward 9+ Creature Trait for 1d10 Rounds. If the wearer gains a Bleeding Condition they must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or the stone will attach itself to the wound. While it is attached, the Bleeding Condition cannot be removed. The stone can be removed by with a successful Average (+20) Strength Test.

name: Workshop - Magic
description: Magic workshop with variety of ingredients and tools required for magic research.

name: Library - Magic
description: Library filled with books about magic.

name: Enchanted Miasma
description: Flask with enchanted miasma. When opened, it releases cloud of gas. Everyone in the room suffer Blinded Condition. If they fail an Average (+20) Endurance Test, they also suffer from the Convulsions symptom for d10 turns.

name: Vial of Schlaf
description: Vial of Schlaff poison. Anyone affected by it shows the following symptoms: slurred speech, apathy, sleepiness, and heave red-rimmed eyes. A Character with medical knowledge may attempt a Hard (-20) Lore - Medicine Test to identify the cause of these symptoms. If a character consumes it, they need to pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain one Fatigued Condition for each dose consumed.

name: Skitter
description:
A mix of Black Lotus, Warpstone, and other unpleasant materials. When consumed, it puts the person in a blissful trance that can last for days. The person must pass a Very Hard (-30) Toughness Test, gaining the Unconscious Condition for a number of hours equal to twice -SL, to a minimum of 4.
Each dose is a Minor Corruption, but if the slumber lasts more than 8 hours it's a Moderate Corruption. After walking up, the person must pass a Hard (-20) Toughness Test or gain a Fatigued Condition that lasts 3 days or until another dose is taken.

name: Censer-Flail
description: Military flail with a hollow head filled with burning coals. Anyone hit by it gets SL Ablaze Conditions.

name: Enchanted Bullet and Powder
description: Enchanted bullets and powder. The bullets ignore all magical armour. The victim suffers -8 SL to casting spells as long as the bullet is in their body. To remove the bullet, someone with Surgery Talent must pass Extended Challenging (+0) Heal Test that requires 8 SL. Each Test requires half an hour.

name: Dangly Wotnotz
description: Bangle or pendant made out of bones, teeth or similar. Used by Orc and Goblin shamans. Allows shaman to reroll 1 Casting Test.

name: Effigy of Gork
description: Shaman who has it may reroll any Melee Tests made to attack an opponent.

name: Effigy of Mork
description: Shaman who has it may reroll any Dodge Tests or Melee Tests made to oppose an attack.

name: Glowy Green Amulet
description: Gives the Shaman Magic Resistance 2 Talent. Every time the bearer is targeted by a spell they must roll 1d100. On 01 they suffer 1d10 Wounds that ignore TB and Armour and gain Prone Condition.

name: Copper Staf
description: While holding the staff, the Shaman is isolated from other Orcs and Goblins. They suffer -2SL to Channelling and Casting Tests. They ignore presence of Orcs, Hobgoblins, and Goblins when rolling on the Waaagh! Miscast Table.

name: Shaman Staff
description: Roll 1d10 for any given staff. The Shaman always counts as being within Willpower Bonus yards of that many Orcs when Channelling, Casting, or rolling on the Waaagh! Miscast Table.

name: Shaman Shrooms
description: The mushroom sprout from the bodies of infested Night Goblin Shamans. When eaten, for the next 2d10 Rounds, the Shaman counts as being within Willpower Bonus yards of 2d10 Orcs when Channelling, Casting, or rolling on the Waaagh! Miscast Table.

name: Gromril Breastplate
description: Highest quality Dwarf Plate Armour.

name: Gromril Open Helm
description: Highest quality Dwarf Plate Armour. Wearer suffers -10% to Perception.

name: Gromril Bracers
description: Highest quality Dwarf Plate Armour.

name: Gromril Leggings
description: Highest quality Dwarf Plate Armour. Wearer suffers -10 to Stealth.

name: Gromril Gromril Helm - v3
description: Highest quality Dwarf Plate Armour. Wearer suffers -20% to Perception.

name: Mail Skirt
description: Dwarf chainmail leg armour. Wearing any Mail imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty.

name: Miner's Open Helm
description:
Open plate head armour topped with candle sockets. It imposes -10 to Perception. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty.
Advanced versions have been adapted to accommodate a directional Storm Lantern.

name: Dwarf Axe
description: Improved version of a regular axe. Well balanced and good against armour.

name: Dwarf Warhammer
description: Improved version of a regular warhammer. Well balanced and capable of pummeling damage.

name: Whirling blades of death
description: Axes attached to chains used by Doomseekers of Grimnir.

name: Dwarf Greataxe
description: Dwarf version of a two-handed battle axe.

name: Dwarf Greathammer
description: Dwarven, large two-handed battle hammer.

name: Dwarf Pick
description: Large dwarven pick. Often sold with a handful of candles, which can be lashed to the weapon as an improvised light source in desperate circumstances.

name: Steam Drill
description: Highly advanced dwarven drilling equipment.

name: Cog Axe
description: Highly advanced, unique dwarven axe that can be use to trap opponents weapon.

name: Steam Gauntlet
description: Highly advanced dwarven contraption. Can be used to do both massive damage and defend against incoming attacks.

name: Dwarf Handgun - v2
description: Dwarven made, medium range, two-handed firearm made out of metal barrel mounted on a wooden stock. More reliable than regular handgun, misfires only on a roll of 100.

name: Dwarf Pistol - v2
description: Dwarven made, compact version of a handgun that can be used with one hand and reloaded more easily. More reliable than regular pistol, misfires only on a roll of 100.

name: Dwarf Crossbow - v2
description: Built by best dwarven craftsman, more deadly than  most regular crossbow.

name: Drakegun
description: Dwarven drakefire gun,  inflicts the Ablaze Condition on affected targets

name: Trollhammer Torpedo
description: Alternative ammunition for Dakegun. With this ammunition, Drakegun loses Penetrating Quality and Reload 4 becomes Reload 6.

name: Repeating Dwarf Handgun
description: Dwarven made, multi-barrel canon capable of 3 shots without reloading.

name: Drakefire Pistol - v2
description: Very rare and powerful weapon. Shoots incendiary projectiles that can set enemies ablaze. Inflicts the Ablaze Condition on affected targets.

name: Grudge-raker
description: Dwarven double-barreled shotgun.

name: Blasting Charge
description: Dwarven explosive used in mining. Inflicts the Ablaze Condition on affected targets.

name: Cinderblast Bomb - v3
description: Full of shrapnel, creates massive and deadly explosion. Often used in tunnel fighting.

name: Dwarf Throwing Axe
description: Dwarven throwing axes are particularly effective against armour.

name: Candelabra
description: used to hold multiple candles. Sold with a dozen of candles. Provides light within 15 yards when lit.

name: Brazier
description: Large source of light. Provides light within 40 yards when lit.

name: Battle Standard
description: Dwarven battle standard.

name: Metal Foil Sheets
description: Thin, flexible plates are used by Runescribes to inscribe a semi-permanent record.

name: Reckoner’s Log
description: Stone tables with grudges inscribed on them.

name: Trade Tools - Brewer
description: Includes pots, buckets, kettles, bottles, etc.

name: Trade Tools - Mason
description: Includes masonry hammer, chisels, pick, spikes, steel tongs, etc.

name: Stone Tablet
description: Used  for inscribing records that withstand the passage of time.

name: Workshop - Brewer
description: Brewer workshops usually have mills, tanks, kegs, and bottling lines.

name: Workshop - Mason
description: Workshop with tools required for most ambitious masonry projects.

name: Shield Platform
description: Platform used by some of the Dwarf lords to get a height advantage in battle. Requires 2 bearers to carry the platform.

name: Oathstone
description: Piece of a Dwarf ’s mountain home carried into battle with them. It is a carved rock inscribed with runes. In combat, character can use Move action to place and stand upon an Oathstone. When standing on it, they: gain +20 to any Tests to resist forced movement, including Tests to resist gaining the Broken Condition; enemies do not gain bonus attack modifiers for outnumbering you in melee, or for attacking you in the side or rear; suffer -20 penalty on all Dodge Skill Tests.

name: Anvil of Doom
description: Legendary anvil required to craft the most powerful runes. It is also required to strike Doom Runes. Provides +20 all Runesmithing Extended Tests. Any Dwarf within 2 yards of an Anvil of Doom gains +20 on Tests to dispel magic with Magic Resistance.

name: Amber Periapt
description: Magical amulet that grants Ward 1 worn by priests of Taal.

name: Bag of Tarrabeth Seed
description: Herb used to distract tracking dogs. Dogs within 5 yards of the herb have to pass an Average (+20) Willpower Test. If they fail, they investigate the bag for 1d10 rounds before resuming tracking. On Astounding Failure (-6 SL or worse) they completely lose the trail.

name: Bag of Soot
description: Darkens equipment and skin to improve stealth in darkness. Anyone trying to spot/identify user receives -1 SL to sight-based Perception Tests.

name: Caltrops (set of 12)
description: Creates 2-yard hazardous area that damages and slows movement. Requires multiple caltrops and 1 Action to deploy. Entering the area requires Hard (-20) Athletics Test. If the character is walking with awareness the Test becomes Average (+20). On Fail: Random leg takes 1d10 damage + Surprised condition.

name: Crampon (set of 2)
description: Boot attachments that affect climbing and movement. Two are required to be effective. +2 SL climbing rock/wood, +1 SL climbing rope. All non-climbing actions: -1 SL Athletics/Agility, -2 SL Stealth, -2 SL other movement Tests.

name: Glass Cutter
description: Tool for cutting glass panels. Requires Average (+20) Art (Engraving) Test to create an opening. If the result of the Test is less than 1 SL, see table on page 33 in Deft Steps Light Fingers.

name: Periscope
description: A device with angled mirrors that allows sight around corners or over obstacles. Enables sight-based Perception Tests while remaining in cover.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: This throwable device provides concealment by creating a thick cloud of smoke, useful for escaping or obscuring vision. When thrown, creates a 10-yard diameter smoke cloud lasting 2d10 Rounds (doubled in enclosed spaces). Vision limited to 1 yard inside the cloud. Characters in the cloud must test for Suffocation.

name: Steel Mummit
description: This specialised breaking tool lets you bypass locks or bolts without picking the lock mechanism. Requires Hard (-20) Sleight of Hand Test to use. If the result of the Test is less than 1 SL, see table on page 33 in Deft Steps Light Fingers.

name: Telescopic Stick
description: Extendable pole reaching up to 12 feet (4 yards). Allows Dexterity Tests to manipulate distant objects with -2 SL penalty.

name: Hunter’s Garb
description: Clothing that lets you blend in better. +2 SL to any Stealth Tests that are made in the appropriate terrain.

name: Dragon Breastplate
description:
Elf-made Dragon breasplate. Wearing any Plate imposes a  -10 Stealth Penalty.
Provides various protections against fire. Detailed rules on p. 35 of High Elf Player's Guide.

name: Dragon Open Helm
description: Elf-made Dragon open helm. It imposes -10 to Perception. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. Provides various protections against fire. Detailed rules on p. 35 of High Elf Player's Guide.

name: Dragon Bracers
description:
Elf-made Dragon braces. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty.
Provide various protections against fire. Detailed rules on p. 35 of High Elf Player's Guide.

name: Dragon Plate Leggings
description: Dragon plate legs armour. It imposes -10 to Stealth. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty (in addition to -10 caused by this item). Provide various protections against fire. Detailed rules on p. 35 of High Elf Player's Guide.

name: Dragon Helm
description: Elf-made Dragon closed helm. It imposes -20 to Perception. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. Provides various protections against fire. Detailed rules on p. 35 of High Elf Player's Guide.

name: White Lion Hide Cloak
description: Cloak made of White Lion pelt. White Lions are native to northernmost High Elf kingdoms, particularly Chrace.

name: Ithilmar Breastplate
description: Elf-made Ithilmar breasplate. Wearing any Plate imposes a  -10 Stealth Penalty.

name: Ithilmar Open Helm
description: Elf-made Ithilmar open helm. It imposes -10 to Perception. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. +1 Enc when not worn.

name: Ithilmar Bracers
description: Elf-made Ithilmar braces. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty.

name: Ithilmar Plate Leggings
description: Ithilmar plate legs armour. It imposes -10 to Stealth. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty (in addition to -10 caused by this item).

name: Ithilmar Helm
description: Elf-made Ithilmar closed helm. It imposes -20 to Perception. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. +1 Enc when not worn.

name: Ithiltaen Helm
description: Elf-made Ithiltaen closed helm. It imposes -20 to Perception. Wearing any Plate imposes a -10 Stealth Penalty. +1 Enc when not worn.

name: High Elf Sword
description: Sword made by High Elves. Well balanced. Common in Ulthuan but not outside of it.

name: High Elf Dagger
description: Dagger made by High Elves. Common in Ulthuan but not outside of it.

name: High Elf Shield
description: Shield made by High Elves. Common in Ulthuan but not outside of it.

name: High Elf Lance
description: Lance my by High Elves. Rare in Ulthuan, even more rare outside of it. If used by attacker without Charging, it count as Improvised Weapon (SB+1 Damage, Undamaging).

name: High Elf Halberd
description: Halberd made by High Elves. Common in Ulthuan but not outside of it.

name: High Elf Spear
description: Spear made by High Elves. Common in Ulthuan but not outside of it.

name: High Elf Great Axe
description: Gear Axe made by High Elves. Well balanced. Scarce in Ulthuan, even more rare outside of it.

name: Greatsword of Hoeth
description: This Elven blade is perfectly balanced and almost as long as an Elf is tall. It has various ornate patterns on blade and hilt, each is a unique work of art. The blade itself is not magical even though it requires magic to craft it. Required for sword-dancing techniques used by Swordmasters of Hoeth.

name: Heartleaf
description: Dried halm emits pungent smell and bright light when burned. A Dragon that inhales the fumes loses 1 Fatigued Condition. Any awakened Dragon becomes immediately aware of burning Heartleaf. Dragons with history of cooperation with Elves may respond positively if treated respectfully and approached for serious reasons. Wild or hostile Dragons are unlikely to be friendly if attracted by Heartleaf.

name: Narinocha Wine
description:
Elvish wine made from narinocha pods, creating relaxation and vivid visions. Drinker must make a Challenging (+0) Consume Alcohol Test. Elves who fail roll on this special Stinking Drunk table:
1-2: Reassuring Mirage - Gain Yenlui (Light). -1 SL to Perception Tests until sober.
3-4: Disquieting Illusion - Gain Yenlui (Dark). -1 SL to Perception Tests until sober.
5-6: Kaleidoscopic Confusion - -4 SL to Perception Tests until sober.
7-8: Vision of the Annuliis - Gain Yenlui (Balanced).
9: Dream of Bucolic Avelorn - Gain Yenlui (Dark). -2 SL to Perception Tests until sober.
10: Nightmare of Mirai - Gain Yenlui (Dark). -2 SL to Perception Tests until sober.

name: Sunroot Extract, vial
description: Health tonic that fortifies constitution when consumed regularly. A vial contains ten doses. One dose mixed with spring water creates a refreshing drink. Character who drinks regularly, receives +20 bonus to Tests resisting disease contraction.

name: Viridescent Palliative
description: Pale green liquid consumed by Elves to calm desires. Each vial contains one dose. Effects last 12 hours after drinking: prevents Frenzy, balances Yenlui, removes Dream/Obsession bonuses and penalties, allows rerolls on failed Cool Tests against Fear/Terror, and forces the drinker to ignore Prejudice, Animosity, or Hatred.

name: Aethyrolabe
description: Device of interlocking brass discs and crystal lenses made by White Tower of Hoeth mages. User can discern relative concentrations of Winds of Magic in an area with a Challenging (+0) Lore (Magic) Test. Can also point to nearest concentration of a specific Wind with a Hard (-20) Lore (Magic) Test.

name: Flamespyre Phoenix Feather
description: Feather plucked from a Flamespyre Phoenix burns brightly for about a year. Casts light with the same intensity as a lantern and can set things ablaze as effectively as a torch.

name: Frostheart Phoenix Feather
description: Feather plucked from a Frostheart Phoenix remains freezing cold for about a year. Casts dim, cold light providing illumination equivalent to a candle. Radiates sub-zero chill that refrigerates with the same efficacy as a brick of ice.

name: Staff of Nightelm
description: Crafted from nightelm trees that once flourished in Ellyrion before being largely destroyed during Asur-Druchii conflicts. If bearer is targeted by spells from Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy, Dark Magic, or any Chaos Lore, they gain Magic Resistance 3 Creature Trait. Sometimes used as shafts for polearms.

name: Staff of the Eternal Grove
description: Wood harvested from the Eternal Grove of Eataine, where trees are bathed in the Winds of Magic. Grows slowly and produces exceptionally hard wood. Crafting items from this wood suffers -4 SL penalty. Polearms and bows made from this material gain the Durable 4 Quality.

name: Wayshard
description: Fragments of shattered waystones or small portable waystones containing Elven soulstuff that protects from predatory gods. Only sold to trusted individuals who will keep them secure. Helps find the nearest waystone and navigate Yvresse mists. Bearer may use it to aid in Yenlui meditation and can make a Challenging (+0) Pray Test to sense the direction of the nearest waystone.

name: Warpstone Charm
description: Skaven Charm provides him with the Luck 3 Talent. If carried by a non-Skaven character, every hour, it for counts as a Moderate Corrupting Influence.
